title: Demand Translation Hub for Prioritizing Enterprise Proposals
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Sales and CS submit a steady stream of large-account feature requests that are heterogeneous in format and signal. PMs spend disproportionate time normalizing asks before any technical scoping or econ can happen. Goal: Build a lightweight Demand Translation Hub (DTH) — a shared triage front door that normalizes incoming enterprise requests into a compact, scored proposal packet (value, risk, feasibility pointers) so PM, Eng, and Solutions can quickly decide next steps. Scope: non-bug feature requests from Sales/CS only; exclude legal/compliance requests and short-term engineering debt items. Deliver a first-pass scoring matrix, a single intake form template, and a routing/hand-off protocol to the existing PRD/Proposal process.
acceptance_criteria: A standardized intake form that maps Sales/CS language to 10 canonical proposal fields (account, use-case, expected ARR impact, frequency, sensitive-data flag, region, integration complexity, suggested rollout cadence, champion, timeline).
A scoring rubric with at least three weighted axes (customer value, technical feasibility, go-to-market fit) that yields an immediate "Go/Review/Reject" recommendation and numeric score.
Operational play: documented routing rules and an SLA for initial PM review within 3 business days and a follow-up plan (discovery ticket, scoping spike, or decline) recorded in Linear.

Pilot ingestion: during a 3-week pilot, capture at least 30 real Sales/CS requests and show a reduction in initial PM normalization time by >=40% versus baseline (baseline measured from Jan-Feb 2026 samples).
Dashboard: a simple dashboard (Looker/Grafana link) surfaces queue size, average time-to-first-review, top requested capabilities, and score distribution.
Artifacts: PRD in Drive, intake template, and a handoff checklist linked and approved by Sales VP and Eng leads.
proposed_solution: Create a lightweight micro-workflow: 1) Single canonical intake form (hosted as a short Google Form + internal UI) that maps to canonical fields; 2) Automated pre-fill hints via a small mapping table (common ask phrases -> canonical fields) to reduce manual edits; 3) A scoring service (simple rules engine) applied on submit to assign numeric weights and an initial recommendation; 4) PM Triage queue with templated responses and routing rules; 5) Pilot with three strategic accounts and two Solutions Engineers to validate fields and weights. Implementation will be incremental: deliver the form + scoring matrix first, then add UI automation and dashboard in week 2-3.

notes: Trade-offs: We purposely keep initial scoring rule-based (not ML) to avoid training data needs and to make weights auditable for Sales. If rule-based scoring yields low cohesion during pilot, swap to a hybrid model (rules + logistic regression) in Q2. Risk: Sales may push for skipping 'feasibility' checks; mitigation: add a mandatory 'technical blocker' checkbox and require SE sign-off for high-impact asks.
